title: Beggar's Canyon Championship
description: Rex 'Speed' Danner is organizing the biggest swoop race on Tatooine—the Beggar's Canyon Championship. Pilots from across the Outer Rim will compete for a prize of 10,000 credits and a custom-built swoop bike. But Beggar's Canyon is no joke—it's dangerous, and many pilots have died trying to master it. Do you have what it takes?
shortDescription: Compete in the Beggar's Canyon swoop race championship

objectives.description: Speak with race organizer Rex Danner
Register for the Beggar's Canyon Championship
Complete the Beggar's Canyon race (finish in top 3 to win)
